mechanism: Estradiol may increase scopolamine levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition and altered transdermal absorption kinetics, while scopolamine's anticholinergic effects may be potentiated by estrogen-induced changes in acetylcholine sensitivity.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, confusion, tachycardia) and consider dose adjustment or alternative antiemetic if toxicity occurs.
